title: ccshelf user config
description: ~/.config/ccshelf/config.toml. Closed schema: unknown keys are errors.

marketplace.description: Plugin sources only: the owner/repo or git URL the plugin's marketplace must have been added from.

remote_url.description: HTTPS URL of a published catalog.json. Credentials, query strings and fragments are not allowed.

update.description: Self-update settings. Absent means mode off: nothing contacts the network unless you run ccshelf update.

mode.description: off (default), notify (one line when a newer release exists) or install (verified update within the same major version).

interval.description: Go duration, at least 1h, at most 8760h. Default 24h.

base_url.description: GitHub Enterprise Server release source: https://host or https://host/owner/repo. https only; no credentials.

cosign_identity_repo.description: github.com owner/repo whose release workflow must have signed the release (a trust decision for forks that sign their own releases). Default: the repository this binary was built from. base_url never changes it.

asset_hosts.description: Extra hostnames a release download may be redirected to (a GitHub Enterprise Server with its own asset or storage host). Exact lower-case hostnames only; no scheme, port, path, IP address or wildcard. A trust decision: the SHA-256 (and with cosign the signature) is still verified.
